scenario: File structure per LGRA.15.10 — optional `use`, then constants / schemas / rules in any order. Pin verifies a const + schema + rule + another const all interleave and compile.
rules_ds:
use default
const LIMIT = 10

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

const MIN = 0

rule r:
    Trig t where t.v > MIN and t.v < LIMIT
->
    log info "x"
